items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said to Joe – I said, “You know what? Let’s just put our book away and play Meditations every night.”

ctx.x: Yep. And by the way, we toured November. We did Meditations every night, because it was the 45th anniversary of Meditations, which is why I did it at the school. So
I said to Joe – I said, “You know what? Let’s just put our book away and play Meditations every night.” Six nights we played it, way out.
